## Manual - CSV Bulk Import

Single Responsibility: accept an uploaded CSV (e.g. an exported bank statement) and create one BudgetFlow transaction per row, via 03 - Create Transaction (which re-validates everything server-side).

Not needed for day-to-day entry — the app's own UI already has a manual transaction form. This exists for bulk backfills only.

Before using: edit 'Map CSV Row to Transaction Fields' to match your actual CSV column headers and resolve a real categoryId (this workflow does not guess categories).
